Verify ledger account 7100 is available for supplier invoice cost posting
Create/register supplier invoice via supplier invoice endpoint for supplier Luna SL with invoice number INV-2026-9045, currency NOK, gross amount 28100
Add supplier invoice line with description 'Servicios de oficina', account 7100, net amount 22480, VAT 25%
Validate calculated VAT amount equals 5620 and total equals 28100

rules: When email is provided, ALWAYS set BOTH email AND invoiceEmail to the same value.
ALWAYS set BOTH amountGross AND amountGrossCurrency to the SAME value on every posting.
Do NOT include postings with row=0 — row 0 is system-generated and will cause a 422.
When using vatType != 0 (e.g. VAT 25%), include ONLY the debit posting. Tripletex auto-generates VAT and credit postings.
For supplier invoices, set supplier={"id": supplier_id} on the debit posting.
For salary/payroll vouchers, set employee={"id": employee_id} on each posting.
Always resolve account numbers via GET /ledger/account?number=XXXX first, then use account={"id": resolved_id}.
Postings with vatType={"id":0} (exempt) can include both debit and credit lines manually.

payload.headline: Agent failed to register supplier invoice due to wrong endpoint approach and hit max steps
what_went_wrong: Agent used POST /ledger/voucher instead of POST /supplierInvoice; the correct endpoint exists (GET /supplierInvoice returned results) but agent was misled by enforcer overrides insisting it doesn't exist.
Voucher postings require balanced entries (sum=0), but agent kept sending only one posting line without the offsetting credit entry, causing repeated 'Summen av posteringene er ikke lik 0' errors.
Agent wasted 10+ identical POST /ledger/voucher calls with the same failing payload, unable to adapt despite consistent error messages, consuming all available steps.
Scoring returned 0.0 with 'Could not reach endpoint' error, suggesting the final successful voucher creation (id 608839409) was not the correct resource type expected by the scorer.
what_worked: Supplier Luna SL was successfully created via POST /supplier with correct org number.
Eventually figured out balanced postings are needed and the final POST /ledger/voucher succeeded (id 608839409).
what_to_try_next: Use POST /supplierInvoice endpoint directly for supplier invoice registration — GET /supplierInvoice confirmed the resource family exists; inspect POST /supplierInvoice more carefully or use the correct payload format.
When voucher postings fail with 'sum not zero', immediately add a balancing credit posting (e.g., accounts payable account) rather than retrying the same payload repeatedly.
Reduce redundant API calls: the 10 identical failing POST /ledger/voucher calls should have triggered a strategy change after the 2nd failure, not the 10th.
unnecessary_calls: Repeated POST /ledger/voucher calls (8+ identical calls) with same failing payload after 'sum not zero' error — should have changed strategy after 1st failure.
